review_notes: Edges are unchanged from the accepted alignment; all 34 source and 39 target IDs are partitioned exactly once.

One change: s033 πρός → 'to … ward' is raised from medium to high. Rule 67 says a frame is never split across tokens and rides with the expressed Greek preposition, and rule 78 settles the head of a discontinuous English wrap on the prepositional word (eleven 'for … sake' units to none). Giving '-ward' to ὑμᾶς would split the frame, so it is not a defensible competing analysis under rule 16.

Three articles are unrepresented for two different reasons: s001 and s009 are emptied by the genitive ἡμῶν occupying the possessive slot (rule 20), each ἡμῶν being free — the ASV spends it on 'our' and nothing else, so rule 76's availability test is satisfied; s017 stands before θεοῦ where the ASV writes no determiner at all (rule 23). In every case the case preposition 'of' rides with the noun (rule 21).

s025 χάριτι is anarthrous, so its supplied 'the' is a rule 7 helper on the noun and not evidence of an article; this is rule 51's anarthrous clause, and it does not conflict with s029 τῷ → 'the', where an article is present to take the determiner.

s031 stays medium. 'abundantly' glosses the lexeme and 'more' spells the comparative degree, which is rule 84's shape, but no corpus line for περισσοτέρως is available in this packet, so a head on 'more' is left as a live competing reading under rule 16. A chapter-level check of περισσ- glosses would settle it either way.
